text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp comes to an end. An eventful summer,
including our expedition to Hokkaido.

Through all that, Mejiro Palmer realized
her genuine desire to simply run, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I love running!
So I want to run! From here on out, too!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Traineeeer, are you sure that's enough?
Seeing them like that just makes me want to do more~."

—A sight like that.
Looking in the direction Mejiro Palmer was gazing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It is finally approaching.
The Kikuka Sho... A long-distance GⅠ perfectly suited for me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Victory at all costs!
And onward to next year's Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
See, someone like McQueen has a totally
different kind of "resolve", right? Before even talking about being strong or weak,
it's her passion for racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In comparison, I just like running,
so I don't really know if I like racing yet~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I wonder if it's really okay for me to just keep
running alongside them like nothing's wrong...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, there's that habit of overthinking again~.
My brain's at capacity. Aaaaaah~!
Mejiro Palmer was troubled. Troubled by the difference in how much passion they poured into racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that. Once I get into something,
I just can't seem to dig myself out of the rabbit hole.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You run because you want to run.
It should be as simple as that, right? And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm surprisingly messed up when it comes to youth stuff...
Sorry for being such a pain of a girl.

She might be a bit complicated, that's true.
Even so...
choice_data_list: Honestly, I think it's fine even if you overcomplicate things.
Honestly, I think it's fine even if you overcomplicate things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oops, are you spoiling me again~?
It's because you're like this, Trainer, that I just can't help it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, since we're already here, maybe I'll let myself be pampered a bit longer. And then~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I need to dig a little deeper during this time!
Into what I truly want to do.
